name: Bubble Permissions
description: Promotes approved Claude Code permissions from project-level settings files and Workshop worktrees up to ~/.claude/settings.json. Runs daily to prevent repeated permission prompts across sessions.
taskPrompt:
Run the permission bubble script and report results:

```
bash ~/.claude/scripts/bubble-permissions.sh
```

Report the full output. If permissions were promoted, list them. If nothing was promoted, say so. If the script errored, report the full error output.
